title: Browser smoke harness hardened for Windows GPU/CDP failure
summary: Chrome and Edge logs showed GPU process fatal exits before the DevTools socket closed. Added software/in-process GPU flags to the local fixture harness; hosted deployment unchanged.

changes.detail: Added in-process GPU, software SwiftShader, GPU compositing and software-rasterizer flags to avoid the observed Windows GPU process fatal exit before CDP interaction.

validation.name: Browser failure diagnosis
validation.detail: Chrome logs showed GPU process unusable/fatal exits and persistent cache lock errors before WebSocket closure.
